About

Operations-minded.
Numbers-driven.

A senior building a career in business operations, analysis, and leadership development — with hands-on work on both sides of the Atlantic.

I’m a Business Administration senior at the University of Kansas (Class of 2027), originally educated in Lagos, Nigeria. My internships have taken me from accounting fundamentals in Lagos, to healthcare billing and revenue assurance in Tulsa, to a Leadership Development Program internship at Warren CAT in Oklahoma City.

That path has given me a practical through-line: I’m at my best improving how work gets done — tracking Work in Progress accurately in Salesforce, following up accounts so revenue doesn’t slip, and keeping financial records clean from voucher to payment.

Outside the office, I’ve captained a soccer team, completed the Kaleo leadership program in Gulf Shores, and volunteered teaching accounting and economics when my community needed teachers.
